name: TLOO-based View Point Selection
aliases: Teaching-Learning Based Optimization for View Point Selection
definition: A method for selecting optimal viewpoints in Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) by optimizing viewpoint entropy and structural features (opacity and luminance) using a hybrid algorithm combining Teaching-Learning Based Optimization (TLOO) and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for cost function evaluation.
summary: TLOO-based View Point Selection is a non-conventional optimization algorithm for Direct Volume Rendering that combines Teaching-Learning Based Optimization with an Extended Kalman Filter to maximize viewpoint entropy without requiring specific controlling parameters.
